g.text: an ender chest pair: same three colours

svg.text: ender chest next to the storage,
wired modem on the storage cable
its twin, next to this computer
• Don't pick the home ender chest in 'storage setup': the storage computer finds it the first time you pull something.
• The linkable kind (EnderStorage): a vanilla ender chest can't be seen by computers. One pair per terminal or builder.
